تستحضروا (form X)
# تَسْتَحْضِرُوا (tastaḥḍirū) /tas.taħ.dˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْضَرَ (istaḥḍara)
# تُسْتَحْضَرُوا (tustaḥḍarū) /tus.taħ.dˤa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْضَرَ (istaḥḍara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
